phase1.explanation:
🐍 **Welcome to the Capstone Project!**

This is where you bring everything together.

**Project Overview:**

You'll build a complete ML system from start to finish:
- Problem definition
- Data collection and cleaning
- Exploratory analysis
- Feature engineering
- Model building and tuning
- Deployment via API
- Documentation and presentation

**Project Options:**

1. **Player Churn Prediction** (Recommended)
   - Predict which players will leave the game
   - Dataset: Player stats, behavior, engagement
   - Target: Retained vs Churned

2. **Game Review Sentiment Analysis**
   - Classify game reviews as positive/negative
   - Dataset: Game reviews text
   - Target: Sentiment label

3. **Your Own Project**
   - Choose a problem you care about
   - Find a dataset
   - Build a solution

**Project Requirements:**

| Requirement | Details |
|-------------|---------|
| Dataset | 1000+ rows, 5+ features |
| Problem | Clear business problem |
| EDA | Complete exploratory analysis |
| Modeling | 3+ models compared |
| Tuning | Hyperparameter optimization |
| Deployment | Flask API |
| Documentation | Complete project docs |
| Presentation | Final presentation |

**Python-chan says:**
"Choose a problem that excites you. Your passion will drive your success."
phase1.openingDialogue: The Capstone Project begins! Choose your problem. 🎯

phase2.explanation:
**Common mistakes to avoid:**

1. **Too broad**
   - ❌ "Predict everything about players"
   - ✅ "Predict if a player will churn in 30 days"

2. **Too complex**
   - ❌ "Build a real-time recommendation system"
   - ✅ "Build a batch prediction model"

3. **No clear success metric**
   - ❌ "Make a good model"
   - ✅ "Achieve 85% F1 score on test data"

4. **No business value**
   - ❌ "Predict something random"
   - ✅ "Predict churn to improve retention"

**Project Scoping Template:**

```
Project Title: [Your Project Name]

Problem Statement:
[What problem are you solving?]

Business Value:
[Why does this matter?]

Success Metrics:
[How will you measure success?]

Dataset:
[What data will you use?]

Timeline:
[How long will it take?]
```
